ln_held_notice: Moved to the briefing (low-distraction mode: only the main conversation or P0 pushes reach the phone). This notice appears in “Needs you” and the briefing, with no alert sound.
kept_notice_one: Not delivered yet: no device that takes notifications is connected now, so the user has not been alerted. It waits for {count} device and shows when that device connects again within 30 minutes (it is lost if the hub restarts first). A chat channel with pushes on, if one is set up, still gets its copy.
kept_notice_other: Not delivered yet: no device that takes notifications is connected now, so the user has not been alerted. It waits for {count} devices and shows when one connects again within 30 minutes (it is lost if the hub restarts first). A chat channel with pushes on, if one is set up, still gets its copy.
filtered_notice: Not delivered: every device that could take it has these notifications turned off, so the user was not alerted. A chat channel with pushes on, if one is set up, still gets its copy. Do not say the user was notified.
no_device_notice: Not delivered: no phone, computer or browser can take notifications from this hub now, so the user was not alerted. A chat channel with pushes on, if one is set up, still gets its copy. Do not say the user was notified.
hub_away_notice: Not sent yet: the hub is unreachable now. The notification is kept and goes to the user's devices once the hub is back, so the user has not been alerted yet.
